hypothesis: CARD/TO_HAND is the second-busiest context on this deck (97 selections per 10 games: every Dawn, Ultra Ball, Poke Pad, Bug Catching Set, Night Stretcher and Lana's Aid target) and falls through to _option_card_power descending, which scores a Basic G Energy at 0.
